description: Ask TBG to match a homeowner with one licensed partner contractor for a remodel, addition, basement, deck/exterior or new custom home in Annapolis / Anne Arundel County, MD. Free to the homeowner. Creates a request in TBG's intake system; it is accepted only with user_consented=true, meaning the person has agreed to TBG's consent text (returned by list_project_options). TBG then contacts the person to confirm.

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant or app submitting, e.g. "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Gemini".

details.description: Short project description in the person's words (max 2000 chars).

name.description: Full name of the person (not the assistant).

user_consented.description: Set to true ONLY if you showed the person this exact consent text and they explicitly agreed: "I agree that TBG may share my details with one licensed partner who may contact me by phone, text or email about this request. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Message and data rates may apply."

name: submit_project_request
title: Request a contractor match
